comments.body:
For guidance on how to use the newly opened Sagres Aide School, please refer to the highly detailed and well-written guide located in the information pane above for more information on how to teach your aide amazing new abilities to enhance your sailing experience. You can share a link to it in-game using this: tinyurl.com/UWO-AideSchool

Or if you prefer a spreadsheet version, visit tab #26 here: tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO

Cheers, and great online learning to you and your aides.

If you are a new beginner or want to go back, please Go To ▶ Sagres

==================
IV: Aide Academy ( 4.3 Shipmate: August 7th 2024)
==================
※ recommend to meet Aide Academy Proffessor first to open Research Building(can take a Research / "Welcome Aide Academy Enrollment Gift") and Aide Academy Instructor last to uncap Aide Trait Limits. It would be better!! You can open Research Building in Sagres if one of your aide's duty reaches 100S(don't need 100S of all 6 duties at first.)

---------------------------
Fast Route to Special Skills

▶ Aide Academy Professor(Beside Mari. Ins.): open Research Building and take a research(+Welcoming Box)
▶ Aide Academy Instuructor(Beside Adv. Ins.): uncap traits of each duty
▶ Aide Academy Professor: complete 3 Skills of Each Duty to unlock Special Skills
----------------------------

1. Aide Information Menu: Research Skill (2 skill slots) menu will be added.
(Trait Skill 1 + Mastery Skill 1)
You can add one more Mastery Skill slot if you use Aide Elite Skill Guide UWC item.

2. New NPCs in Sagres: Aide Academy Instructor / Aide Academy Proffessor will be added.

1) Aide Academy Instructor(Right Side of Adv. Course Instructor):
Uncap trait limit of each duty by Quest!

2) Aide Academy Professor(Beside Mari. Course Instructor):
Open Research Building or Start & Report of Aide Academy Research
Reward: Aide Academy Enrollment Gift

3. Aide Academy Content

1) Unlock Upper Limit of Aide's Trait: By Quest
NPC: Aide Academy Instructor beside Adv. Course Instructor

※ Pull a Quest: Each player has to use QMP separately! can't share with your fleet members. (Choose One of 3 Quests which each duty shows)
※ Quest Complete: Unlock Upper limit of Traits from 100S to 120SS and change color from Sky Blue to Yellow (ex: 100S → 100S)

Where to Report: Only in Sagres

------------------
NAVIGATOR (Sailing)
------------------
Pre-requisite: 100S Navigator Trait

Not Available: SSBT etc.
Available: Solar Barge
Report to Port Official after Arrival!

(1) Tacoma: have to visit Tacoma with your Aide Captain within 80 Days!
※ To Tacoma: SSBT/Railway/Canal (X)
※ To Sagres After Quest Complete: Railway/Canal (O) SSBT (X)
(2) Hawaii: have to visit Hawaii with your Aide Captain within 80 Days!
(3) Guam: have to visit Hawaii with your Aide Captain within 80 Days!


------------------
LOOKOUT (Sea Battle)
------------------
Pre-requisite: 100S Lookout Trait

Have to call your Aide Captain!
Your Aide Captain must Survive during the Battle!
Available Item: AOS, Letter of Appreciation
Helpful Item: Pegasus Feather after Battle

(4) Bergen: Defeat NPC Fleets with your Aide Captain near Bergen (north) [180/1815]
(5) Trebizond: Defeat NPC Fleets with your Aide Captain near Trebizond (north)
(6) Nagasaki: Defeat NPC Fleets with your Aide Captain near Nagasaki (south)


------------------
PAYMASTER (Trade RTG)
------------------
Pre-requisite: 100S Paymaster Trait

Sell RTG of this cycle and make a certain amount of profit at a time at one of ports in this area.
※ A Certain Amount of Profit: 50,000 Ducat or more

(7) Caribbean Sea Culture Area
(8) Northern Europe Culture Area
(9) Southeast Asia Culture Area

● RTG, 19th Oct. Azuki Beans / Pearl Millet / Tomatoes / Upland Rice / Bananas / Mate Tea / Peanuts / Anchovies / Hake / Indian Mackerel

An easy way this cycle is:

1) Get the Northern Europe Quest
2) Buy Upland Rice in Casablanca
3) Sell in Bergen



------------------
STORE KEEPER (Deliver Trade Goods)
------------------
Pre-requisite: 100S Store Keeper Trait

(10) Santo Domingo: Deliver Leatherwork X 1600 to Market Keeper within 30 days
(11) Kokkola: Deliver Mercury X 1600 to Market Keeper within 30 days
(12) Natal: Deliver Brandy X 1600 to Market Keeper within 30 days


------------------
LIEUTENANT (Land Battle)
------------------
Pre-requisite: 100S Lieutenant Trait

Defeat NPCs with your Aide Captain.
Your Aide Captain must Survive during the Battle.
Notice: Railway/Canal/SSBT cannot be used while on this quest! Railway/Canal can be used after completing the quest.
Helpful Item: Pegasus Feather after Battle

(13) South America Southeast Coast(▶Paraguay River Upstream):
near Ruins (Top-left of the map)

(14) Guatemala(▶Northeast Guatemala▶Copan River North Shore):
near Table Boulder

(15) Island of Java North Coast(▶Java Island Interior):
near Flower-Red(South of the map)



------------------
SURGEON (Sailing without Abnomalities)
------------------
Pre-requisite: 100S Surgeon Trait

DO NOT FORGET TO USE "VEIL"!!!
Report to Port Official after Arrival!

(16) Veracruz: sail with your Aide Captain without any abnomalities!
(17) Tamatave: sail with your Aide Captain without any abnomalities!
(18) Valparaiso: sail with your Aide Captain without any abnomalities!

2) Aide Academy Study: similar to Oxford / Boston Research
NPC: Aide School Professor beside Maritime Course Instructor

Where To Report / Take
First Time to take: In Sagres
Report and 2nd Time Take: Sagres / Scholars in other Cities/towns
Scholars:
▶ Normal Cities/towns(including Nation Cities such as Trujillo): can take study and report
▶Company colony: can report your study, but can't take another new study

For more detailed Info: tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO => Tab 26 Aide Academy

(1) Trait Skills: +1R Boosting

※ Can unlock Mastery Skills after submitting 18 Topics.
Each Duty requires 3 Topics. (6 X 3 = 18)
Navigator / Lookout / Paymaster / Store Keeper / Lieutenant /Surgeon

※ Can add the skills to your Aide Captain, the 2nd Aide at the same time and can activate those skills while you are playing however, the same skill won't stack though you give it to your aide captin/2nd aide both.

Ex) Aide captain: Accounts the 2nd Aide: Accounts
The skill rank increases +1, NOT +2

(2) Mastery Skills (NEW SKILLS!!)

※ Can add the skill to your Aide Captain or the 2nd Aide.
(Except for Resurgence / Double Magic / Unlock Trick)
※ Mastery skills can't be shared with your fleet members.

-------------------------
① Negotiation Techniques (Required 120SS to unlock: X)
Hagglling 11%(Max) up, So Total 141% can be avilable (including Legendary Tycoon 30% up)

Topics: 30 Page: 8000 Acq.Points 4,000 Req.Points 10,000
-------------------------
② Accounting Support (Required 120SS to unlock: Store Keeper)
The amount of Renego Consuming will decrease while you are haggling, cause this skill prevents the price from returning the inicial value though you failed the 2nd/3rd haggling.

Topics: 18 Page: 3000 Acq.Points 1,500 Req.Points 5,000
-------------------------

The number of Attack/Defense increase +30(Max) each when the Liutenant of your aide reachess 120SS

Topics: 22 Page: 5000 Acq.Points 2,500 Req.Points 7,500
-------------------------
④ Messenger (Required 120SS to unlock: X)
(Ornament + Equipment with Reduce Vigour consumption) X 90%=> 100S Surgeon
(Ornament + Equipment with Reduce Vigour consumption) X 34%=> 120SS Surgeon
The skill will be very helpful at all kinds of battles. The time consuming will decrease dramatically. Skill grinding will be also easier than before.
